articles.title: Trump asked Musk to lift Starlink slowdown, WSJ reports
articles.description: Elon Musk, a critic of Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, had ordered the slowdown of SpaceX's Starlink, The Wall Street Journal previously reported.

articles.title: Meta’s deal to keep Zuckerberg in California adds fuel to wealth tax debate ahead of election
articles.description: With less than two weeks before the midterm elections, Meta made clear that Mark Zuckerberg is staying in California if the wealth tax passes.

articles.title: Disney’s multiplatform Super Bowl plan frustrates ABC affiliates
articles.description: Disney is airing the Super Bowl on ABC, ESPN, Disney+, ESPN2, ESPNU, and NFL Network, to the chagrin of local station affiliates.

articles.title: OpenAI nears up to $30 billion funding round at $1.25 trillion valuation led by UAE investors
articles.description: OpenAI is close to finalizing a new funding round that is meant to be a bridge to its 2027 IPO, sources familiar with the matter tell CNBC.

articles.title: ChatGPT Teaches Messi Chess—On a Board It Set Up Wrong, With an Opening That Loses in Four Moves
articles.description: Lionel Messi’s ChatGPT ad has the AI teaching him chess on a board with kings and queens swapped, then suggesting an opening that loses in four moves on that board.

articles.title: Dune launches real-time data feeds covering 200 onchain trading venues
articles.description: The new service aims to bring onchain trading data into institutional financial systems as tokenized stock markets expand and face growing scrutiny.

articles.title: Trump defends Ramaswamy ad with Acton's estranged mom after bipartisan criticism

articles.title: Lawsuit accuses Trump of illegally profiting off foreign crypto deals
articles.description: "We're suing to stop the corruption and to force President Trump to return the profits to American taxpayers," attorney Matt Pelikan told CNBC.

articles.title: CoreWeave’s market confidence erodes as bond yields spike and stock sinks

articles.title: a16z Drops Crypto From Its Name, Widens Bets to AI and Frontier Tech
articles.description: Andreessen Horowitz is renaming its crypto fund a16z Frontier and widening its scope to AI, autonomous machines and biology, saying the line between crypto and everyday tech has blurred.

articles.title: Reported fraud losses among older Americans hit $3 billion in 2025 as big losses surge: FTC report

articles.title: Moderna shares plunge after leak of cancer vaccine data despite positive results
articles.description: Moderna's stock fell even though the full data, released later Thursday, appeared positive based on Wall Street expectations ahead of the release.

articles.title: SpaceX and Tesla have high election stakes as Elon Musk pours $366 million into campaigns

articles.title: Meta Creates Non-Voting Stock to Fund AI Buildout, Keeping Zuckerberg in Control
articles.description: Meta will hand shareholders a free non-voting share for every share they own in January, giving it a way to raise equity for AI spending without diluting Zuckerberg's 60.6% vote.

articles.title: Musk's clash with Ukraine accelerates demand for Starlink alternatives. Few exist
